tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
TP-Link Archer AX15 AX1500 Wi-Fi 6 Gigabit Router

Upgrade your home network with the TP-Link Archer AX15 AX1500, a powerful Wi-Fi 6 router built for speed, efficiency, and stability. Offering combined speeds of up to 1.5 Gbps (1201 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz), it’s perfect for 4K streaming, online gaming, video conferencing, and smart home devices.

Key Features:

  • Next-Gen Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax): Faster speeds, increased capacity, and reduced latency for smoother performance across multiple devices.
  • Dual-Band Technology: Minimize interference with simultaneous 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands for optimized speed and stability.
  • OFDMA & MU-MIMO: Communicate with multiple devices at once, reducing lag and improving efficiency across the network.
  • Beamforming Technology: Directs the wireless signal to connected devices for stronger, more reliable connections.
  • Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Includes 1× WAN and 4× LAN ports for fast, wired connections to PCs, gaming consoles, and smart TVs.
  • TP-Link Tether App: Simple setup and network management from your smartphone, including device monitoring and parental controls.
  • Advanced Security: WPA3 encryption, built-in firewall, access control, and VPN support to keep your network safe.
  • Wide Coverage: Designed for homes with multiple rooms, providing stable Wi-Fi in every corner.

Ideal For:

  • Homes and small offices
  • High-speed internet plans
  • Multiple connected devices
  • Streaming, gaming, and video calls
